4862.title: Provider startup waits can outlive the Node event loop
4862.rootCauseOneLine: The provider startup fallback timer is unreferenced, so an otherwise idle process exits successfully before pending registration waits finish.
4862.proposedFix: Keep the existing provider-registration fallback timer referenced while waits are pending.
4862.caveats: Direct registry lifecycle reproduction on Linux; packaged macOS startup and the reporter's database were not executed.
